name: inline_comment
description: Read the inline instruction comment at an address, defaulting to the current cursor. Returns null when absent; use set_inline_comment to write one.

__schema0.description: The active target's provider document name; use open_binary to switch targets

__schema2.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

document.description: The active target's provider document name; use open_binary to switch targets
